claims.statement: Runtime connector composition uses immutable offline defaults, explicitly injects a database-backed receipt ledger into all write families, validates the complete 20-operation catalog registry, and rejects real/network selections or registry corruption before any database transaction.

The existing exact-keyed deterministic model and all eight typed connector families produce stable business results, independently validate schemas and bounds, preserve untrusted provenance, and reject unregistered, disabled, or unauthorized operations without real-provider fallback.

Reconstructing the configured bundle and database engine returns the original write receipt without a new effect. Audit-fault and lost-response recovery reconcile durable receipts only after the lease and call-deadline bounds, preserving one physical mock effect and exact dispatcher authorization.

All five demo acceptance paths retain deterministic replay-safe outputs under socket denial. Email uses the shared durable connector factory, makes no mock write before all approvals, and recovers a post-receipt crash without duplicating the newsletter or CRM effect.

limitations: The process-local low-level connector builder remains for isolated tests and is rejected by the dispatcher gateway. Runtime writes must use the durable factory with the same persistent receipt database across reconstruction.

Only the five registered demo renderer/schema pairs are supported. Unknown pairs fail closed; no real provider or connector SDK, credentials, live network calls, or production side effects are included.
Failure injection uses trusted test renderers and gateway/UoW wrappers; no user-selectable production fault-profile setting is added.

File-backed SQLite tests create initial metadata directly and reopen it without schema creation for restart checks. Migration, seeding, process bootstrap, and PostgreSQL execution remain outside DEL-03.

Durable mock idempotency is not a claim of universal exactly-once delivery for future external providers. Connection witness retains the new factory/tests while restoring its configured ledger-injection seam to the base.
